newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES END LOWER AT 20.0625 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES END LOWER AT 20.0625 PERCENT.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates ended lower on Monday after Saturday's 25 basis points repo rate cuts by the National Bank of Hungary (NBH), dealers said.
"The drop was due to both the repo rate cut and ample liquidity," said Laszlo Egyed of West-LB Hungaria.

The NBH reduced the overnight repo rate to 26.75 percent from 27 percent, the one-week repo rate to 26.75 percent from 27 percent, the overnight reverse repo rate was cut to 17.25 percent from 17.50 percent.
The one-week reverse repo rate was cut to 20.75 percent, from 21.00 percent and the one-month reverse repo rate was cut to 21.25 percent from 21.50 percent.
On Monday, overnight rates opened between 20.125 and 20.375 percent and closed at 20.0625 percent compared with Saturday's close of 20.50 percent.

Traders said overnight rates would probably remain around currnet level for the rest of the week as most banks had already filled their reserves and all players sought to lend money with tens of billions of forints available on the market.
